name: Transcribe a recording
description: Turns a meeting, interview or voice note into a clean transcript and a short summary, on this computer.

inputs.label: Recording
inputs.help: An audio or video file inside the chosen folder (MP3, M4A, WAV, MP4).

inputs.label: What should the summary focus on?

output: transcript.md and summary.md next to the recording.
author: ZED-ZEN

tools.purpose: reads the audio from the file

alternatives.label: Smaller speech model
alternatives.description: Uses a smaller model: faster and lighter, a little less accurate.
alternatives.promptNote: Use the tiny model: pass --model "$ZEN_WHISPER_MODEL_TINY" to transcribe.py.
